title: Muse-Glimmer-30B + DFlash drafter — Vulkan vs ROCm through llama-swap, prefill/decode curve by depth

serving.layer: llama-swap :9292 (swap-on-demand; backends started manually by the operator)
serving.note: gen_campaign.py cannot emit this lifecycle (its run.sh hardcodes serve_llamacpp.sh); driver is the hand-written exception per iron rule 6 — user chose manual starts. Recommended follow-up: teach gen_campaign.py a `source: llama-swap` server mode.

build_design.kind: 2x2 factorial: {vulkan, rocm} x {b10969 upstream 391fac1, stew675 fork v16-r4}
build_design.history: Original decision (2026-09-15): matched stew675 pair. First vulkan pass ran b10969-vulkan-system anyway (latest-vulkan symlink was never repointed; config still uses the ${vulkan} macro) — kept and tagged 'as-deployed'. User then chose to complete the factorial: +rocm-b10969 and +vulkan-stew675 arms. Yields both matched pairs (b10969 vk-vs-rocm, stew675 vk-vs-rocm) plus the per-backend build effect.

rocm-b10969.status: pending — flip latest-rocm to b10969-rocm, reload -dflash-rocm

vulkan-stew675.status: pending — flip latest-vulkan to the stew675 Vulkan build, reload -dflash

build_design.reason: llama-swap's ${vulkan}/${rocm} macros resolve to build/latest-* symlinks that were promoted independently: latest-vulkan=b10969-vulkan-system (upstream 391fac1) vs latest-rocm=b790cf51aa-stew675-rocm (fork v16-r4 b862fc3). As-deployed would confound version with backend (iron rule 2).
build_design.provenance: run.sh resolves each loaded server's binary from GET /running (readlink -f) and records it per pass in meta.txt; warns if the resolved path is not the arm's expected build. Rows in results.jsonl carry the arm label, so every number is attributable to a build (rule 2).

spec_decoding.note: n_max 15 is a LOCAL choice (one below the 16-token diffusion block), not vendor — models.yaml; p_min 0.4 IS measured (2026-08 sweep). Identical on both arms → backend is the only variable.

servers.name: muse-vulkan
servers.binary: build/latest-vulkan/bin/llama-server (resolved at load; the measured pass ran b10969-vulkan-system — see build_design)

servers.name: muse-rocm-b10969
servers.binary: build/latest-rocm/bin/llama-server (operator flips latest-rocm -> b10969-rocm for this arm)

servers.name: muse-vulkan-stew675
servers.binary: build/latest-vulkan/bin/llama-server (operator flips latest-vulkan -> b790cf51aa-stew675-vulkan-1.4.357.1 for this arm)

vram.note: weights_gib INCLUDES the 1.52 GiB drafter (18.41 + 1.52). KV geometry MEASURED via bench/gguf_kv.py: arch muse-glimmer, 52 attn layers, 52 KiB/tok f16. Predicted full-ctx ≈ 29,064 MiB < 32,400 budget.

notes: Depths 8/32/64/96K per iron rule 16 (>=4 points for a log-log prefill-decay fit per backend; ctx is PINNED at 131072 = trained depth, so 98304 + 512 output leaves ~32k headroom). prefix_mode=unique = cold prefill per rep (uuid prefix defeats the cache) — this measures the backend compute shape, NOT the incremental agentic cache-reuse pattern (rule 17); that is a documented out-of-scope follow-up. Untimed warmup=1 matters for Vulkan (first prefill compiles shaders). Vendor reference: Muse-Glimmer card CLAIMS 74.9 -> 233.4 tok/s (3.1x) with the DFlash drafter on an RTX 5090 — different GPU, provenance CLAIMED.
